47dea7cfcdeac25101b615a6671ea7c3f57d2b0a.summary: The /btw panel now supports follow-up questions in the side thread, replaces 'Add to conversation' with 'Send to chat' to send your message plus the side thread to the main agent, and raises per-question limits to 25 turns, 50 tool calls and 10 minutes.

01a855f6d21e8777358dd1534f5f7c27a8a15518.summary: Background agents spawned in one batch with overlapping owned paths are now rejected with workspace_conflict, writers waiting on workspace write access show as queued with the blocker, and read-only agents get clearer guidance about scripts.

cf5857f771495dee83fc721fa77cbe5e294f413d.summary: File approval cards now share one rule editor with folder-prefix defaults, outside-workspace write cards keep their layout, rule patterns wrap, and a new Allow Folder for Session button approves a file's folder in one click.

0dc88b64a80cf3e0976cdd81c4553d23578eb752.summary: The Approve for Me Guardian now receives host-measured diffs and session-edit facts for git checkout/restore file reverts, so it can approve restoring a session's own edits without the agent printing the diff first.
